texts.value: Mediates high affinity thiamine uptake, probably via a proton anti-port mechanism (PubMed:11731220, PubMed:33008889, PubMed:35512554, PubMed:35724964). Has no folate transport activity (PubMed:11731220). Mediates H(+)-dependent pyridoxine transport (PubMed:33008889, PubMed:35512554, PubMed:35724964, PubMed:36456177)
